title: Heads-Up Texas Hold'em
description: Compete head-to-head against AI across Flop, Turn, and River.
htmlLayout: Ante 50 pts to startCommunity Cards revealed during showdown

actionHandlers.start: if (state.points < 50) return alert('Insufficient points'); state.points -= 50; window.thActive = true; document.getElementById('th-status').innerText = 'Hand started! Click Showdown to reveal.'; updatePointsDisplay();
actionHandlers.showdown: if (!window.thActive) return; window.thActive = false; if (Math.random() > 0.4) { state.points += 100; document.getElementById('th-status').innerText = 'You won the pot of 100 pts!'; } else { document.getElementById('th-status').innerText = 'Opponent won with better pair.'; } updatePointsDisplay();
